# SchoolDigger.com

> > SchoolDigger provides comprehensive K-12 school data, test scores, and boundaries via JSON API for 120,000+ US schools.

SchoolDigger.com is a leading resource for school information and data in the United States. The platform offers developers and educators access to detailed school data through its API and widget solutions.

## Key Topics

- SchoolDigger API
- K-12 Schools
- School Data
- Test Scores
- School Boundaries
- JSON API
- Data Integration
- Widgets
- Bulk Download
- Developer Access

## API Documentation

- [SchoolDigger.com API - Power your website or application with SchoolDigger data](https://developer.schooldigger.com/): JSON API for 120,000+ US schools with test scores, boundaries, and data
